steps.title: Make Your First Plan
steps.body: Each step connects an intention, an observed outcome, and a thoughtful next decision.

steps.title: Declare What Matters
steps.body: Create one commitment. Creator will record why it matters and which systems it changes.

steps.title: Record the Outcome
steps.body: Timeline compares intention with action so ChronoSpark can adapt future decisions.

steps.title: Build Behavioral Evidence
steps.body: Repeated outcomes give Progression and Trajectory Engine stronger evidence about what is sustainable.

steps.title: SI Console
steps.body: Inspect why a decision was made, which evidence supports it, what is uncertain, and what to do next.

steps.title: Your first plan is ready
steps.body: ChronoSpark can now help you choose a next action, learn from the outcome, and show how your path changes. Replay this guide from Settings anytime.
